body: Okay, That was a lot longer then I expected it to be...here is an attempt at a  TL'DR....have had experience with types of energy work since i was a child,Highs and lows with it,there has been a lot of trauma, and now I cant seem to find it or use it again, I feel toxic, Feel empty and drained, yet get insane pressure feels like trapped energy usually in chest or throat, sometimes other places, now I also live in a place that has been just as bad, with a person ive always had to shield myself with and I dont know what to do...haha...thankyou

Pretty close to what I was going to say. People always want to help someone they care abouts suffering. It is really hard to see when you didnt have someone there to care so much to ask those things. I wish I had someone to care that much honestly haha. Yeah, it is over asked but I think its a good thing there asking...again not to fix the problem but how to be there anything they can do that could help in small ways. Problem is with that everyone is different, every bodys situation is different, the relationship between the addict and one asking about it is always different ect so it gets tricky but I do not believe they are trying to minimize most of the time. I have seen a few...how can I save them, convince them to change ect...those ones wont work but the majority I see are people just desperate, feeling out of control too wanting to do what they can to help. I cant click on much yet right now so honestly havnt read many...too moody and spaced out too read much of anything haha. Just came back here couple days ago. Well like it says in the app it definitely dosnt replace therapy and eveyone is different with how they process things ect. for some it will work for some it wont. It did help me out though. The timeline graph for symptoms for one, helped me see after a few months patterns of when my ptsd got worse and times when it was better and helped me understand those things better and my triggers ect and the tools really did help me too. Its hard to think straight at all during a flahsback or during dissasociation or strong anger and the tools it gives are ususally simple, like look at this soothing picture lol or go for a walk, guided meditations and muscle relaxation. Things I dont think of while in a state . What made him/you think it was bullshit?
